about: Leads for Castelbuono and the Madonie above it, started from a reader tip on r/sicily, 2026-10-23.

leads.name: The Hollies of Piano Pomo
leads.place: Piano Pomo, Madonie park, between Castelbuono and Petralia Sottana
leads.source: reader tip on r/sicily, 2026-10-23 (no name kept): 'some enormous Hollies near Castelbuono, some estimated up to 900 years old', with https://luoghi.italianbotanicalheritage.com/en/piano-pomo-holly-trees-holly-forest/ ; Regione Siciliana register (elenco aggiornato al 17.07.2026) row 'Agrifogli di Piano Pomo', comune Petralia Sottana, 37°53'57.63" 14°03'57.63", 1,400 m, girth 430 cm, height 15 m, listed as a group; the same list has a field maple (380 cm) and a beech (470 cm, 26 m) at Piano Pomo
leads.note: A grove of giant hollies at 1,400 m in the Madonie, a walk from Piano Sempria above Castelbuono (the register also lists a 890 cm sessile oak and a 530 cm oak at Sempria, Castelbuono sheets 11 and 03). The 900 years is the heritage site's estimate, not the register's; keep it as theirs. Needs: which trunk, an open-licence photo, and the walk from the Sempria refuge. Reachable by car only.
